top_signals.title: Lagarde says EU funds should take first losses on chip plants, data centers
top_signals.summary: Public funds should absorb early risks in major technology projects, the European Central Bank chief said Friday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Houthis Warn of Attacks on Saudi Red Sea Ports
top_signals.summary: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis threatened on Friday to attack Saudi Arabia's Red Sea ports if Saudi-led coalition forces struck the strategic Red Sea port of Hodeidah."We warn all employees, workers, and those in the vicinity of these ports to evacuate them immediately and stay away.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Einride books $167M in contracted revenue, targets $250M
top_signals.summary:
Einride expects to exit 2027 at about $250 million in annualized run-rate revenue, with more than 65% covered by contracts, after Q3 revenue rose 27% sequentially to $18.3 million.
